risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, but it presents meaningful credit deterioration, including higher criticized commercial loans, rising non-performing loans, and increased loan-loss provisions. Management offsets these concerns with growth and earnings messaging, while relying on exclusions, one-time-event adjustments, and forward-looking caveats to moderate the apparent risk.
